title: Avoid primary key index name format allocation
description: Replace default primary-key index name construction via format! with preallocated helper builders.

criteria: Composite primary-key default index names no longer use format!("{}_pkey", table_name)
ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY default index names no longer use format!("{}_{}_pkey", table_name, column_name)
Generated index name bytes remain unchanged

notes: Default index names now append into a single preallocated String.
Explicit primary-key constraint/index names remain cloned unchanged.
A SQL regression covers ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY without an explicit constraint name and verifies the SHOW INDEXES name.
